lp.heroLead: AI MedSmarter connects patients, pharmacists, physicians and pharmacies around one clear medication plan, with an assistant that always shows its sources.
lp.proto: Prototype · fictional data · not for clinical use
lp.sampleQuestion: What should I do if I miss a dose?
lp.sampleAnswer: Take it when you remember, unless the next dose is close. Never take a double dose. (Fictional demo answer.)
lp.problemTitle: Medicine plans are easy to lose track of
lp.problemNote: These are design hypotheses to validate with user research.
lp.problem1Body: Complex schedules and busy days lead to missed or doubled doses.
lp.problem2Body: Patients search the web and find unreliable, unsourced advice.
lp.problem3Body: Between visits, clinicians see little of adherence and side effects.
lp.solutionTitle: One plan, one assistant, one care team
lp.sol1Body: Schedules, reminders and warnings in plain language.
lp.sol2Body: Every answer cites approved sources and states how well they match.
lp.sol3Body: Pharmacists and physicians review what matters.
lp.howTitle: From prescription to peace of mind
lp.step1Body: From your physician or entered by you.
lp.step3Body: Log how you feel and ask the assistant.
lp.step4Body: Only what you choose to share.
lp.role.patient.1: Next dose and reminders at a glance
lp.role.pharmacy.1: Inventory and expiry in one view
lp.aiTitle: An assistant that shows its work
lp.aiLead: Not a generic chatbot. It answers from approved sources, tells you how well they match, and hands off to a person when it should.
lp.ai1: Source citations and evidence on every answer
lp.ai3: Says «I don't know» instead of guessing
lp.ai4: One tap to ask a pharmacist
lp.safetyTitle: AI advises. Rules and people decide.
lp.safe1Body: Interactions and contraindications come from a rules engine, never from a language model.
lp.safe2Body: Pharmacists and physicians confirm anything that affects treatment.
lp.safe3Body: Answers cite versioned, reviewed sources. No source, no answer.
lp.privacyTitle: You decide who sees your data
lp.priv1Body: Clinicians see your data only with your permission, and you can withdraw it.
lp.priv2Body: See who viewed what and when.
lp.priv3Body: Small groups are hidden. No individual patient data is shared.
lp.futureTitle: Designed to connect, not yet connected
lp.futureLead: The prototype uses no real external system. These are planned interfaces only.

grounded.quality.title: About these sources
grounded.quality.explain: This describes where the information comes from. It is not a probability and does not say the answer is medically right.
grounded.limits.title: Limits
grounded.limit.evidence_publication_date: Publication dates of the sources are not recorded; only when we received them.
grounded.limit.evidence_demo_data: Some information is fictional demonstration data and not for clinical use.
grounded.limit.evidence_stale_source: Some sources were received a long time ago and may be out of date.
grounded.limit.evidence_source_date_unkn: For some sources we do not know when they were received.
grounded.limit.evidence_conflict: Sources disagree on some points. We do not choose between them.
grounded.limit.evidence_incomplete: Some information you may be looking for was not found.
grounded.limit.evidence_truncated: Only part of the available information is shown.
grounded.limit.evidence_quarantined: Some source text was left out because it looked like instructions to the assistant.
grounded.limit.evidence_excluded_rejecte: Some rejected statements were left out.
grounded.limit.screen_keyword_based: This check works on keywords. It can react to general questions and can miss real emergencies. It is not a medical assessment.
grounded.missing.title: Not found in the sources
grounded.evidence.title: Sources and evidence
grounded.evidence.sub: What the sources say, in their own words, kept apart from the answer text above. Numbers like [E1] in the answer point here.
grounded.err.title: That did not work

grounded.err.unauthorized: Your account is not allowed to use the assistant.
grounded.err.rateLimited: Too many questions in a short time. Wait a moment.
grounded.err.invalid: The question could not be processed. Check its length and try again.
grounded.err.server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again later.
grounded.proto.title: Prototype conversation
grounded.proto.body: This conversation shows scripted sample answers. Voice, image and "ask a pharmacist" do not work yet. For answers from real sources use the source-based page.
